notes.title: Devlog #1 - A New Baddie!
notes.content:
[h1]Devlog #1 - Meet a new Baddie![/h1]

Hey there! Paul here, the developer behind [b]Geometric Link[/b]. If you're reading this, welcome to the very first entry in what I'm calling my devlog series. Think of these as little chats between you and me, where I spill the beans on what's new, what's challenging, and all the cool stuff I'm working on for the game.

So, [b]Geometric Link[/b] has been my baby for the past six months. It's been a wild ride of coding, designing, and, let's be honest, a fair bit of head-scratching. But hey, that's game development for you!

Today, I'm super stoked to introduce you to the latest thorn in your side - a brand new enemy that's going to up the ante in [b]Geometric Link[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657324/8d6260b7071a6193730b2975931c576393cfa89b.gif[/img]

He is a wheel shaped enemy that will accellerate towards the player but with very bad steering capabilities. So if you dodge he will have to brake, turn and reaccellerate towards you.

This enemy is supposed to break the monotony of movement in the enemies and also bring a new challenge to look out to.
If you're interested in how he was created, there is a timelapse here

[previewyoutube=CCeTbOH9JA4;full][/previewyoutube]

These devlogs are all about sharing the journey of making [b]Geometric Link[/b] with you. From brainstorming sessions that end up nowhere to those eureka moments in the wee hours of the morning, I'm laying it all out there. Your feedback and thoughts mean the world to me, so don't be shy!

Can't wait to share more with you. Keep an eye out for the next devlog!
